title: Melhoria do Tasks
body:
Seria ideal se nas tarefas também se pudesse mudar a cor, conforme o tipo de tarefa e conforme a fase de execução. 

Seria bom que as tarefas pudessem ter 3 fases: arranque, continuidade e termo.

title: Do better!!
body: PLEASE, I beg you to make this app better. In terms of widgets, ergonomics, design, everything really. Please, for the sake of everyone's life, do better.
author: Marta Pita

title: Nice, but…
body: I really like that the tasks are linked to the google calendar, which helps my task management, but I feel like the widget could have a better design since the two options are too simple, looking more like a blank square than an actual widget.

body: Hoje eu tinha na minha lista de lembranças em dois horários distintos e não fui avisada por esta aplicação
author: 19790Cv!

title: Very good overall task app
body: The app it self is simple and effective. The fact that this app communicates with connection Google calendar makes it worth the while, you can schedule your tasks in the same place you have your other appointments. However it fails in more advanced features as priority labeling or even scheduling sub-tasks.

title: Move tasks between lists
body: This should be an easy feature, and is not available. Need to delete task in one list and recreate it in another
author: zemariacp

title: Sugestão
body:
Olá,

Aproveito para apresentar a seguinte sugestão: quando  uma actividade / nota fosse concluída pelo utilizador, a mesma deveria ser registada no calendário na data e hora que foi concluída e não na data prevista para conclusão.

Obrigado.

Bruno Matos

title: Not compatible with iPad
body:

Also, if you creat subtasks, and sort the main tasks by date, subtasks will not appear below their main task.
